recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨大的多核巨噬細胞，三個小而圓的核分布在淡藍灰、帶細纖維紋路的豐富細胞質中，呈皺紙狀外觀，符合高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）。
features: Giant histiocyte with three small round-to-oval nuclei
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine fibrillary/wrinkled texture
Nuclei have moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Irregular cell border with cytoplasmic projections
No phagocytosed red cells or discrete vacuoles; normal surrounding marrow elements
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant multinucleated histiocyte with three small round nuclei embedded in abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm that has a fine fibrillary, wrinkled texture. The surrounding hematopoietic cells appear unremarkable, and no hemophagocytosis is identified. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell, supporting Gaucher disease in the appropriate context; enzyme assay and GBA1 testing are required to exclude pseudo-Gaucher cells.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher histiocytes in CML, myeloma, or thalassemia look similar but have normal glucocerebrosidase activity and an associated primary disorder.
Osteoclasts contain many more uniform nuclei in granular, more basophilic cytoplasm without fibrillary striations.
Niemann-Pick cells show uniform small lipid vacuoles (soap-bubble appearance) rather than striated cytoplasm.
